Subject: HelioBank — Dedicated capacity sizing & technical deep-dive: proposed times

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key takeaways from discovery:
- Primary workload: real-time transaction monitoring (fraud scoring) + post-transaction enrichment flows.
- Target model family: Llama-2-70B / equivalent finetuned variant.
- Performance targets: 99th percentile tail latency <= 120ms for online scoring; sustained throughput ~650 tokens/sec (~60 qps for typical prompt lengths).
- Peak concurrency: expected burst to 250 concurrent sessions during morning trade windows.
- Data and compliance: PII redaction at edge, VPC private deployment requested.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute Dedicated Capacity Sizing + Technical Deep Dive where we:
1) validate qps/concurrency numbers and prompt distributions,
2) align on target latency SLOs and fallback model variants,
3) review network/KMS requirements for a Private deployment, and
4) walk through our dedicated pool sizing options and cost/latency tradeoffs.

Available slots (PDT):
- Fri Apr 9 10:00–11:00am
- Mon Apr 12 9:00–10:00am or 1:30–2:30pm
- Tue Apr 13 3:00–4:00pm

If none of these work, send a couple alternatives and we will accommodate. Please confirm who from your side should join the call (I recommend Alex + an infra/ops person and procurement on the follow-up).

Prep from your side that will make the session highest-impact:
- sample prompt length distribution (tokens per request),
- expected qps and concurrency windows by hour,
- any model quantization constraints (must use fp16 or prefer 4-bit),
- a short list of critical SLAs (latency percentiles, error budget).

Attachments: HelioBank-discovery-notes.pdf (call notes), redwood-capacity-primer.pdf (handy glossary and sizing primer).

Thanks — I’ll loop in Dev and Neha from the solutions team to run the deep dive.

—Marissa
